title: FBS Federation Message v1.0.0
description: HTTP POST message delivered to peer node inboxes to propagate Barcode Records and federation activities. Defined in RFC FBS0001 Section 4.4.2. This schema is also accessible as federation-message.schema.json.

id.description: Unique HTTPS URL identifier for this federation message.

sender.description: HTTPS base URL of the sending node.

recipient.description: HTTPS base URL of the receiving node.

activity.description: Type of federation activity. Includes key lifecycle (KeySuccessionDeclaration, KeyRotation), security notices (NodeCompromiseNotice, TransparencyAlert), custody operations (CustodyTransfer, CustodyAccept), and connectivity checks (Ping/Pong). See RFC FBS0001 Section 4.4.3 for specifications.

object.description: Primary payload object. Varies by activity type: Barcode Record for Publish, lightweight reference for Retract, Namespace Claim for ClaimPublish/ClaimRetract, KeySuccessionDeclaration or KeyRotation document, NodeCompromiseNotice or TransparencyAlert notice. May be null for Ping/Pong.

publishedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the message was created in ISO 8601 format.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded Ed25519 signature of the sending node over the canonical federation message (RFC 9421).
